The momentous first preseason race of the 
Aoharu Cup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm a tiny bit nervous, but don't worry!

text_block_list.text:
Our goal is to BANG Team <First>! We cannot 
stumble here, no way! Absolutely not!

Joining forces with everyone on the team, 
we'll deliver a happy race, yes we will!
